title: The Nixpkgs core team has disbanded
summary: The Nixpkgs core team has disbanded, marking a significant governance crisis in the Nix ecosystem. This represents a major organizational failure in one of the largest open source package repositories, raising concerns about open source sustainability and maintainer burnout.
problem_solved: This article documents rather than solves a problem - it reports on the collapse of governance structures in the Nixpkgs project due to maintainer burnout and interpersonal conflicts.
why_valuable: It highlights critical issues around open source governance, maintainer sustainability, and the challenges of managing massive community projects with volunteer labor.
